actionTip: Runs the code (or the selection) on several databases of this connection and merges the results

dialog.title: Run on several databases
dialog.intro: The editor code (or the selection) runs on each chosen database, each in its own session and {{max}} at a time. The results are merged in the results panel.
dialog.noDatabases: Could not read the databases of the connection.
dialog.readOnly: The connection is read-only: any statement that is not a read is rejected.
dialog.empty: There is no code to run.

confirm.title: Confirm changes on several databases
confirm.write_one: The code is not read-only (it has {{keyword}}). It will run on {{count}} database and may change it.
confirm.write_other: The code is not read-only (it has {{keyword}}). It will run on {{count}} databases and may change all of them.
confirm.unknown_one: On this engine it is not possible to verify that the code is read-only. It will run on {{count}} database and may change it.
confirm.unknown_other: On this engine it is not possible to verify that the code is read-only. It will run on {{count}} databases and may change all of them.

summary.messages: See the per-database detail in Messages.
